## 🎯 Key Features Delivered

### Agent Management
- **Multi-type Agents**: Conversational, Task-Oriented, and Reactive agents
- **Dynamic Discovery**: Automatic component discovery from Agno framework
- **Lifecycle Management**: Create, update, execute, and delete agents
- **Session Management**: Persistent agent conversations and context

### Workflow Engine
- **Visual Workflow Builder**: Drag-and-drop interface for creating agent workflows
- **Trigger System**: Multiple trigger types (manual, webhook, scheduled, event-based)
- **Conditional Logic**: Branching and decision points in workflows
- **Data Flow Management**: Seamless data passing between workflow steps

### Integration Layer
- **Backward Compatibility**: Existing Langflow flows continue to work unchanged
- **Mixed Workflows**: Combine Agno agents with traditional Langflow components
- **API Compatibility**: RESTful APIs with WebSocket support for real-time interaction
- **Database Persistence**: All agent and workflow data persisted and recoverable

### Production Features
- **Comprehensive Testing**: Unit, integration, and performance test suites
- **Multi-Environment Deployment**: Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud deployment options
- **Monitoring & Observability**: Metrics, logging, and health checks
- **Security**: Authentication, authorization, and rate limiting
